embedding_tie_treatment: Embedding matrix is stored once; full matrix participates as tied dense LM head each decode step. Embedding lookup is not another full pass.
bandwidth_derivation: 22.4 Gbit/s per pin *256 bits /8 =716.8e9 bytes/s; rated spec, no clock or achieved bandwidth measured.
assumptions: Dense BF16 projections and full-vocabulary tied head evaluated every incremental step; no quantization/compression/speculation/skip/offload.
Output32 minus output1 approximates31 extra forward steps; first prefill/sampling/graph planning may differ, so measured difference is not pure decode.
No-retention scenario rereads dense matrices once per step, ideal perfect within-step reuse. It is a conditional streaming reference, not unconditional physical lower bound.

L2-credit model assumes at most64MiB of persistent weight data, no persistent L1/register residency across steps; all other dense weights fetched from DRAM at least once. Capacity and that assumption are not newly measured.
Nominal rated bandwidth is optimistic; no DRAM counters, achieved clock, refresh, write/activation/KV/logprob overhead, contention or overlap measured.
Ideal B2 reuses same weight pass for both requests, hence batch delta near single average; two independent passes give near2. H2 can also yield ratios near1 or2.
hardware_claim: No PPA, energy, memory-bound diagnosis or new hardware mechanism follows from byte estimates.
